fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-14 11:30 to 2026-11-15 11:30 UTC
Pause: running (the 2026-11-14 report has no 👍 yet; one unacknowledged, the rule pauses at two).

1. Decisions for you: one new, five carried (each a proposed decision in the group log).
- NEW. Structured findings for `record validate` and `container validate` (6882f577, srs-rust#1339 remainder). Fact: thirteen slices of #1339 landed; the last two surfaces have no stable code taxonomy, so a builder would have to invent codes, which is a contract ruling. Why it matters: editors parse English today to tell failure kinds apart; #1339 and the text-list retirement (#1496) wait on this. Options: (1) diagnosticsStructured beside errors, one kebab-case code per ValidationError variant, defined once; (2) carry them in the error envelope (ADR-053), changing where clients look; (3) leave text-only. Recommendation: (1). Action: decide. Urgency: low.
- May the group merge a Door 3 revision that only executes a ratified ruling? (de6b88c5, SP-02). Recommendation: (c) as a 30-day trial. Action: decide. Urgency: low.
- Field identity rules (21b6b4b7, srs#236, 16 days): srs#1016 landed, so it may be overtaken. Rule on it or close. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Heading-outline continuity (864eaebf, srs#991, 16 days): one rule, after a downstream audit. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Is editor UI in the mandate (bc6bc746, srs-web#691, 11 days): route it to WG Agent-supported editor. Action: decide. Urgency: low.
- `note delete` default (c7a8e0a2, srs-rust#1497, 18 days): refuse notes with inbound Relations unless `--cascade`. Action: approve. Urgency: low.
Also waiting for your merge (approve): srs#1033, #1034, #1035, #1036, #1037, all `gate:owner-merge`, each citing a ruling; untouched since 14 Nov.

2. Decided within mandate: none ratified this cycle (no decision was ready: no merged PR named a proposed group decision). Merged PRs cite ADR-057, decision bf4a5af5 and ADR-048 rule 6 as mandate.

3. Done: 2 PRs merged, both `gate:auto-merge`:
- srs-rust#1664 run-state refusals name the status by its wire spelling (#1339, slice 13): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / mandate 00567bf1 (ADR-048 rule 6).
- srs-rust#1663 render export-bundle gets diagnosticsStructured (#1339, slice 12): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / mandate bf4a5af5.

4. Stuck or lost: open group PRs (8):
- srs#1021: approved, `gate:auto-merge`, state `unstable`, 3 days with no merge. Waits on the merge step.
- srs#1033 to #1037: Door 3, owner's merge (section 1).
- srs-rust#1646 (#1510): rejected, behind master, no change in 4 days; builder's to fix.
- srs-web#782 (#336): rejected, merge conflict, no change in 5 days.
Stops (needs-input): as before (srs-rust#1495, #1164, #731, srs-web#691); not re-read. Merged PRs without a quorum line: none. Owner-ruled escalations missing from either log: not re-checked.

5. Budget: 2 of 10 delegated merges this cycle (group-state read after the close reads 0, as its window had just reopened); 8 open. Pause state: running.
5b. Awaiting ratification: the six proposed decisions in section 1 are the only ones pending. Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: open `ready` + `wg:third-party-ready` issues (not PRs): srs 2, srs-rust 9, srs-web 1, srs-vscode 0, semanticops.com 0 (12; some blocked or landed). Top 3 in the builder's order (oldest first, stopped ones skipped): srs-rust#1496 (stopped on 6882f577), srs-rust#1635, srs-rust#1636. Local priorities: none. Queue fed for about 1 cycle. Waits on the owner: six decisions and five Door 3 merges. Fed by the analyst: 2026-11-11 (filed 10 rulings, unparked 4).

6b. Exercises: not re-read this cycle; the open ones in the last report stand.

7. What we learned: the group is slowing: two merges, and the builder's remaining ready work is mostly gated on owner rulings (Door 3 merges, the #1339 code taxonomy). The queue is fed but blocked on the owner, not the builder. Build trigger (about 10 ratified decisions, then srs-web#560): not counted, not flagged. Measurement I1: 0 of 0 PRs in the window (it opens at the 11:30 cycleStart, so it is empty again); result bf6a26bc-f3a2-4f0a-ba69-9e73ad1ce8e4. Whether it is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
